scope: ThemeLab relocatable runtime and legitimate local X11 session guards

changes.resource_root: Discovered relative to PACKAGE/tools/theme-lab/build/theme-lab; explicit --root remains validated.
changes.container_policy: Owned non-symlink directory without group/other write; existing mode is preserved.
changes.path_policy: Package output is a new direct child of the private container; preview output rejects parent segments and verifies every existing directory as owned mode 0700.
changes.x11_policy: Local DISPLAY plus private owned Xauthority plus authenticated AF_UNIX peer matching the display number.
changes.r584: Canonical receipt, manifest, gtkrc and 112 verified assets are package resources.
changes.family_diagnostics: Declared package resources and installed runtime capability are reported separately.
changes.missing_runtime_resources: native_colors.cpp plus the lightweight Kvantum palette/config transaction modules are packaged and declared.
changes.clean_home_chain: The launcher creates ~/tempia and ~/tempia/domainos-theme-work in sequence when HOME is genuinely empty; it does not chmod an existing container.

relocated_package_evidence.startup_warnings: 19 avisos de fontes ausentes no HOME mínimo; a interface permaneceu ativa até o timeout esperado.

unavailable_runtime_families.gtk1: GTK1 is not installed and has no implemented native gallery.
unavailable_runtime_families.gtk5: No GTK5 runtime or gallery is available; it is not simulated.

generation_evidence.reuse_for_final5: The final5 manifest differs from final4 only in the rebuilt C launcher binary; every generation and preview resource hash is unchanged.

native_preview_evidence.recipe_applied_semantics: Capability and generation summaries keep recipe_applied=false when no GUI was initialized or family coverage remains partial. The native gallery receipts set the per-control recipe to applied=true only after the generated QSS/SVG was attached to the listed real widgets. Kvantum applies only the scrollbar recipe; its other controls remain explicitly untranslated.

validation_incidents: Uma versão anterior do teste alterou momentaneamente o contêiner domainos-theme-work de 0755 para 0700. O modo observado antes do teste foi restaurado imediatamente; o teste foi corrigido e a validação final confirmou 0755 sem nova alteração.

A primeira compilação separada do helper de cores herdou do CMake um caminho de saída fixo e relinkou tools/theme-lab/build/theme-lab-colors. O processo compartilhado não usa nem mapeia esse helper. O Makefile agora fixa a saída no BUILD solicitado e as compilações seguintes ficaram isoladas.

O candidato final4 falhou ao iniciar com HOME realmente vazio porque ~/tempia ainda não existia. O launcher passou a criar ~/tempia antes do contêiner do projeto; final5 permaneceu ativo até o timeout esperado e criou toda a cadeia com modo 0700.
limits: No visual fidelity or human acceptance is inferred.
No other user account was used.
No global KDE, GTK or X11 setting was changed; the final filesystem permission state matches the state observed before validation.
No ThemeLab window was reopened on the user's desktop during final validation; native GTK captures and clean startup used an owned Xvfb.
GTK1 and GTK5 remain unavailable rather than being simulated.
